outcome_analysis.explanation: The current completed official evaluations make this a both_fail pair: parallel solution_passed false with 0/181, serial solution_passed false with 34/181. The process and artifact difference is concrete even without pass/fail discordance. Parallel blocked final delivery behind a single oversized sqlsplit child and never produced test2.mjs; serial implemented and packaged the full entry-plus-library tree but still had semantic sqlparse compatibility gaps.
parallel_contributors: The sqlsplit child was the indispensable implementation path and remained unfinished when the active turn was canceled.
The parent planned entry-point assembly after the swarm result, so cancellation before a complete swarm result left no test2.mjs.
serial_contributors: The serial actor wrote the full artifact tree, including test2.mjs and sql splitter modules, before timeout.
Serial's local differential testing found and fixed several cases, but fuzzing still exposed remaining compatibility defects.
ordinary_implementation_differences: Serial's splitter implementation remained semantically incomplete, which explains its overall official failure despite artifact validation success.
outcome_analysis.causal_scope: No discordant official pass/fail outcome; this explains the observed artifact and score gap, not a unique root cause of an official pass/fail difference.
